theorems.name: A Caplet Is P(0,T1) Times the Black-76 Caplet at the Zero Curve's Forward Rate
theorems.description: In a BondModel for a stochastic discount factor D with D T1 > 0, measurable and integrable, D T0 integrable and D T1 * l(T0) integrable, let Q' be the T1-forward measure (forwardMeasure of the bank account 1/D T1) and suppose l(T0) = F exp(-sigma^2 T/2 + sigma sqrt(T) Z) Q'-a.e. with Z standard normal under Q' (BSCallHyp at drift 0). The lognormality of the forward rate under the forward measure is a hypothesis; it is not derived from a short-rate model.

theorems.name: The Bond Price at t > 0 in the Vasicek Model Is Affine in the Short Rate
theorems.description: For the Vasicek discount factor D t = exp(-int_0^t r_s ds) (the integrated short rate in its Wiener representation, kappa > 0), the natural filtration F of the driving Brownian motion, and t <= T, the zero-coupon bond price bondPrice mu F D t T = E[D T | F t] / D t equals A(T-t) * exp(-B(T-t) * r_t) almost surely, where r_t = vasicekSDEMean + sigma * int_0^t e^{-kappa(t-u)} dB_u is the short rate in its Wiener representation and A, B are the coefficients of the time-0 bond price at the remaining maturity T - t. theorem bondPrice_vasicek' {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}

    (r₀ θ σ : ℝ) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) {t T : ℝ≥0} (htT : t ≤ T) :

        * Real.exp (-(vasicekBondB κ ((T - t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
          * (vasicekSDEMean r₀ θ κ t + vasicekDiffusionTerm hB κ σ hκ.le t ω))) :=
  MathFin.Contracts.bondPrice_vasicek hB hBm r₀ θ σ hκ htT
